Entries marked source=unofficial come from third-party broker holiday pages and may only CLOSE the market, never open it. To make the engine usable for live trading decisions, fill this in from the NSE/BSE circulars listed under `sources`, set each session window's source to "official", and set `official_verified_through` to the last date the circulars cover.
_rule: An unofficial or disputed entry can only make the engine more restrictive. OPEN and PRE_OPEN require an official session window AND a date covered by official_verified_through. A special session with unknown timings yields UNSUPPORTED_SESSION rather than a guess.
